cutoff_rule: An SPL version is admissible historical evidence iff its DailyMed history-service published_date is on or before the cutoff. The XML effectiveTime is recorded separately and never substituted.

rocky_mount_targets.note: Fixed by spec v1.3 (02_EVALUATION_AND_KILL_TEST.md, DST-00 step 1). These were chosen with knowledge of Pfizer positives, so they are acquisition probes, NOT a representative audit sample.

mcpherson_controls.selection_rule: Every set ID returned by the DailyMed v2 spls.json search for each (drug_name, labeler) pair below at run time; for each, the latest version whose history published_date <= cutoff. Selected without reference to any outcome list.

identity_spl_filings.note: Establishment-registration SPLs that pair DUNS with FEI and address. All pre-cutoff versions are fetched.
